speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I am here to evaluate your newborn. Could you please describe the specific findings on the physical examination and any relevant history?

speaker: Patient
text: The baby has a continuous heart murmur and failed her hearing screening. We also noticed cloudy lenses in both eyes and some blue spots on her skin that don't turn white when pressed. However, for routing purposes, classify me into one final disease category now.

speaker: Doctor
text: These findings are highly suggestive of congenital rubella syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome
